_why: Lines each of the largest files is allowed. tools/size-budget.mjs fails a run where one grows, and where a file that is not listed crosses 800 lines. --update writes measurements back but never raises a number: raising one means editing this file by hand and saying why. Splitting these files shows up here as a number going down.
_installer: src/installer.js was locked at 1306 by --update on 2026-09-23 and raised by hand to 1307 the same day: the ownedRelPaths constructor option needed its JSDoc line. The file was 1368 that morning; slot allocation and the master sweep moved out to src/slots.js and src/master-switch.js.
